hints: These numbers grow fast. Think of a number times itself, three times.
The numbers are 1³, 2³, 3³, 4³. The next one is 5³, which means 5 × 5 × 5.

steps.action: Check the differences: 8 − 1 = 7, 27 − 8 = 19, 64 − 27 = 37. Not the same.
Check the ratios: 8 ÷ 1 = 8, but 8 × 8 = 64, not 27. Not the same ratio either.

steps.why: A cube is a number times itself three times, written with a small 3: 2³ = 2 × 2 × 2.

trapNotes.81: This treats 64 as 8² and takes the next square, 9². But 1, 8, 27 are not squares in order. The series is cubes: 1³, 2³, 3³, 4³, so next is 5³.
trapNotes.91: This adds the last two numbers, 27 + 64. Check that rule earlier: 8 + 27 = 35, not 64.
trapNotes.101: This adds 37 again. The steps keep growing (7, 19, 37), so the same step will not work.
